observation_indicators.observable_fil: Natutukoy ang limang hazard group; sa napiling halimbawa, may posibleng pinsala, agarang kontrol at taong lalapitan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Identifies all five hazard groups and gives potential harm, immediate control and a reporting contact for the chosen example.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi nakikita ang panganib o paalalang “mag-ingat” lang ang aksyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Misses the hazard or gives only “be careful” as the response.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Natutukoy ang limang hazard group; sa napiling halimbawa, may posibleng pinsala, agarang kontrol at taong lalapitan. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Identifies all five hazard groups and gives potential harm, immediate control and a reporting contact for the chosen example. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Natutukoy ang panganib ngunit kulang ang contact o kontrol; ipapunan ang apat na field bago ulitin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Names the hazard but omits contact or control; complete all four fields and repeat.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi nakikita ang panganib o paalalang “mag-ingat” lang ang aksyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Misses the hazard or gives only “be careful” as the response.
